prerequisite: BE-05 software integrated and exact-main verified; Explorer remains PUBLIC_PREBIND / UNBOUND.
principles: Explorer observes FAE; it never authorizes FAE.
Provider infrastructure is availability/persistence only, never consensus or chain-selection authority.
Only the read-only gateway may be exposed publicly; the Independent Node remains loopback/private.
No wallet seed, private key, transaction signing, transaction submission, mining, consensus, or economic authority may enter the host.
Stability Soak V3 and all other protected workstream infrastructure remain isolated.

runtime.os: supported Linux distribution with current security updates

accepted_identity_modes: stable DNS name with automated ACME renewal
public IP certificate with automated short-lived ACME renewal
tls.ip_certificate_note: If no stable DNS name exists, a public IP certificate is acceptable only with an ACME client that supports short-lived IP certificates and automatic renewal; renewal failure must fail closed before expiry.
tls.port_80_use: ACME validation and HTTPS redirect only

persistence.node_state_semantics: Locally validated derived state; persistence accelerates recovery but never grants provider authority.
persistence.filesystem_permissions: writeable only by dedicated runtime identity; not world-readable/writeable
restart_acceptance: record validated tip and state-file identity before restart
restart service and verify same durable state is loaded
reboot instance and verify state remains present and node resumes local validation
fresh-bootstrap path remains possible if state is deliberately removed

logging.retention_goal: operational evidence only; avoid unbounded disk growth

forbidden_without_separate_authority: paid static IP or networking add-on
egress plan or overage with expected nonzero charge

required_before_creation: provider account and home/eligible region observed
selected compute shape is explicitly free-tier eligible
selected boot/durable storage is inside free entitlement
network/egress exposure has a fail-closed no-surprise-billing disposition
provider-specific reclamation/preemption risk has an explicit disposition
no protected FAE workstream capacity is consumed

requires_after_provisioning: be05-binding-probe.mjs GREEN on exact public HTTPS origin
only then may later authority permit BOUND_CANDIDATE
